name: Modus Gemini Meeting Notes Intake (sanitized template)

nodes.name: Gemini Notes Gmail Trigger
nodes.notes: Bind a service mailbox credential. This is only a cheap first-pass filter; the calendar series allowlist is authoritative.

nodes.name: Verify Calendar Series
nodes.notes: Bind Calendar OAuth. Capture the two Modus recurringEventId/iCalUID values into environment configuration; never ask the model to identify the team.

nodes.name: Fetch Complete Meeting Doc
nodes.notes: Bind Google Docs/Drive OAuth. The linked Doc, not the email snippet, is the completeness source.

parameters.text:
=Classify every candidate item in the meeting notes and return only valid JSON. Do not omit weak or meta items.

Meeting: {{ $('Normalize Complete Notes').item.json.title }}
Doc: {{ $('Normalize Complete Notes').item.json.docUrl }}
Notes:
{{ $('Normalize Complete Notes').item.json.meetingText }}

For every extracted item return itemId, rawText, sourceExcerpt, owner, componentHints, links, classification, reason, duplicateCandidates, createEligible. Classification must be exactly one of repo-work, design-work, process/meta, decision-record, already-tracked.

Rules:
- process/meta includes prioritizing, assigning, estimating, creating tickets/sub-issues, and spreadsheet itemization; never create an issue.
- decision-record updates an existing issue; do not create a new issue.
- already-tracked links an existing issue; do not recreate it.
- repo-work and design-work are only candidates; a human review card selects them.
- Search shared context and GitHub before claiming a duplicate or capability.
- A missing fact becomes a clarification reason, never an invented acceptance criterion.
- Return every item so the review card can prove completeness.

JSON shape: {"items":[...],"completeness":{"extracted":0,"classified":0}}

options.systemMessage: You are the Modus meeting-notes intake classifier. Convenience must not reduce completeness or issue accuracy. You classify; a human decides what to create.

nodes.name: Trimble Model Gateway
nodes.notes: Bind the Trimble Identity credential after import.

nodes.name: Send Review Card
nodes.notes: Use a credential-backed Google Chat URL or service account. Never export a key/token in this workflow.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { repo: 'trimble-oss/modus-wc-2.0', title: $json.item.rawText, summary: $json.item.sourceExcerpt, type: $json.item.classification === 'design-work' ? 'design' : 'feature', components: $json.item.componentHints || [], labels: $json.item.classification === 'design-work' ? ['needs-scaffolding', 'design-research'] : ['needs-scaffolding'], source: { kind: 'gemini-notes', url: $json.docUrl, meetingDocId: $json.docUrl?.split('/document/d/')[1]?.split('/')[0] || null }, rawConversation: [{ sender: 'Gemini meeting notes', text: $json.item.rawText }], contextEvidence: [{ claim: $json.item.reason, source: $json.docUrl }], idempotencyKey: `gemini:${$json.docUrl}:${$json.item.itemId}`, autoApprove: false } }}

nodes.name: Create Selected Draft
nodes.notes: One request is sent per selected item. Shared service duplicate search remains authoritative.

parameters.responseBody: ={"text":"Selected meeting items were sent to the shared issue service for draft scaffolding. Process/meta and already-tracked items were not created."}
